domain: Clinical Research / Clinical Trial Management (GxP Computer System Assurance)
app_concept: Halcyon CTMS — Assurance: the validated-systems module of a clinical trial management suite, where every automated qualification run of the study's EDC software is filed as a Part-11 controlled Qualification Run, scoped under the configuration stream it was executed against and closed out by a countersigned Execution Certificate.
modalities: accordion-collapsed + hover-reveal-tooltip, on a record identified only after the scattered runtimes are compared
scope-gated-listing (navigator-held scope is the only expression of stream attribution)
